name: transition_theory
title: Predictive theory of branch selection and global MSE near the certified exchange
status: sealed with 00_THEORY_PLAN.md before any Monte Carlo outcome was read (seal 1)

setting.signal: x_t = exp(-i z s_t) + exp(+i z s_t) + eps exp(i phi) exp(i b s_t), s_t = (t - (N-1)/2)/N, t = 0..N-1 (advcore.make_signal)
setting.frequency_units: u, with tone exp(i u s_t); strong pair at u = -2, +2; weak tone at u = 10
setting.cost: J(u; y) = min over c in C^2 of ||y - V(u) c||^2, unweighted residual sum of squares (advcore.Objective)
setting.branches: A and B: noiseless local minimizers continued from the frozen crossing roots (s6_noise.noiseless_roots); certified orientation A below eps_c, B above
setting.noise: w_t iid circular complex Gaussian; Re w_t, Im w_t ~ N(0, sigma^2/2); sigma^2 = (||x(eps)||^2 / N) * 10^(-SNR/10)
setting.labels: A if max-norm unordered torus pair distance to the noiseless A root < 1.0; else B if distance to B root < 1.0; else OUT
setting.empirical_P_A: n_A / n with OUT counted as not A
setting.global_MSE: mean over all n records (OUT included) of squared Euclidean distance between sorted fitted pair and sorted u_W
setting.u_W: u_A for eta < 0; u_B for eta >= 0 (frozen S7 table and Stage-6 MSE_to_winner; A-referenced values at eta = 0 are MSE_to_A)
setting.local_covariance: frequency block of s6_noise.local_cov(x, u_j, sigma2): (sigma^2/2) H^-1 Re(J^H J) H^-1 with residual curvature in H

theory.Delta0: J_A(x(eps)) - J_B(x(eps)), locally optimized branch costs
theory.P_A_primary_version_B: Phi(-Delta0(eta) / s_Delta(eta)), all quantities at eps_c(1+eta)
theory.g: dDelta0/deps at eps_c = 2 Re <r_A - r_B, exp(i pi) exp(i b s)> (envelope theorem); not the small-spacing tangent Gamma
theory.orientation_requirement: g > 0 so that P_A decreases through 0.5 as eta increases through 0
theory.W_10_90_exact_curve_secondary: eta(P_A_primary = 0.1) - eta(P_A_primary = 0.9) by root finding on the deterministic continuation
theory.eta50_predicted: root of Delta0(eta) = 0 (0 to float precision); local form: 0
theory.MSE_pred: P_A [tr C_A + ||u_A - u_W||^2] + P_B [tr C_B + ||u_B - u_W||^2]
theory.within_mode: P_A tr C_A + P_B tr C_B
theory.MSE_pred_primary_uses: P_A_primary_version_B and the frozen u_W convention
secondary_descriptive: A-referenced MSE_pred at eta = 0 against MSE_to_A

implementation_checks.g_float64: envelope vs centered FD of re-optimized costs, h = 1e-4 eps_c and h/2, Richardson; pass rel diff <= 1e-6
implementation_checks.g_mpmath: 50 digits, Newton-polished roots, centered FD with h = 1e-12 eps_c at the crossing; pass rel diff <= 1e-20
implementation_checks.d_norm: ||r_A - r_B|| at crossing and all 13 eta (float64); crossing also in mpmath; pass rel diff <= 1e-9
implementation_checks.variance_formula: fixed d_c, M = 2000000 draws, SeedSequence([20260928, 99, 1]); pass |var/(2 sigma^2 ||d||^2) - 1| <= 5 sqrt(2/M) and |mean|/s_Delta <= 5/sqrt(M)
implementation_checks.orientation: P_A > 0.5 for eta < 0 and < 0.5 for eta > 0 at every SNR, both versions
implementation_checks.roots_reproduced: float64 continuation recomputed; J rel diff <= 1e-9 and u abs diff <= 1e-7 vs noiseless_roots.json
implementation_checks.no_fit: every input deterministic and listed here

empirical_quantities.W_emp: DONE.json probit_widths[snr].width_10_90 (preregistered MLE probit P(A) = Phi(q0 + q1 eta), OUT as not A)
empirical_quantities.brier_theory: sum over eta of [n_A (1 - p)^2 + (n - n_A) p^2] / sum n

criteria.C1_orientation_and_crossing: P_A_emp(-0.20) > 0.5 and P_A_emp(+0.20) < 0.5 and slope_emp < 0 and |eta50_emp - eta50_pred| <= W_pred/2
criteria.C5_MSE_central: 0.5 <= MSE_emp/MSE_pred <= 2.0 at >= 5 of the 9 central points
criteria.F1_width_scaling_wrong: |(W30/W40)_emp / (W30/W40)_pred - 1| > 0.25 (not blind: widths quoted in the task)
criteria.F2_orientation_or_crossing_wrong: at 30 or 40 dB: orientation test fails, or slope_emp >= 0, or |eta50_emp - eta50_pred| > W_pred
criteria.F3_MSE_missed: at 30 or 40 dB: MSE_emp/MSE_pred outside [0.1, 10] at >= 5 of the 9 central points
criteria.STRONG_PREDICTION: C1..C5 hold at both 30 and 40 dB
criteria.20_dB: stress test only; reported, never used in the classification

prohibited: new eta or eps Monte Carlo points
new signal family, N, z or model order
fitting any parameter to noisy outcomes
